gloss: waters; water area; body of water

definitions.gloss: waters; water area; body of water
definitions.explanation: A defined area or expanse of water, whether a river, lake, ocean, or other waterway. Often used in official, environmental, and regulatory contexts.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{水域|すいいき}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{遊泳|ゆうえい}⟦{禁止|きんし}→禁止：02643_kinshi⟧です。
examples.english: Swimming is prohibited in this water area.

examples.japanese: ⟦{汚染|おせん}→汚染：02595_osen⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧{水域|すいいき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{浄化|じょうか}→浄化：14936_jouka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{進|すす}んでいる→進む：01225_susumu⟧。
examples.english: Cleanup of the polluted waters is underway.

examples.japanese: ⟦{港|みなと}→港：01512_minato⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{周辺|しゅうへん}→周辺：09896_shuuhen⟧{水域|すいいき}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大型|おおがた}→大型：03016_oogata⟧{船舶|せんぱく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{航行|こうこう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{制限|せいげん}→制限：03375_seigen⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Navigation of large vessels is restricted in the waters around the port.

notes:
A compound of {水|すい} (water) and {域|いき} (area, zone). This is a somewhat formal and technical term used in environmental science, maritime regulation, and geography.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{閉鎖|へいさ}→閉鎖：14524_heisa⟧{水域|すいいき}: enclosed waters (bay, lake)
- ⟦{沿岸|えんがん}→沿岸：13280_engan⟧{水域|すいいき}: coastal waters
- {内陸|ないりく}{水域|すいいき}: inland waters
- {水域|すいいき}⟦{汚染|おせん}→汚染：02595_osen⟧: water area pollution
- ⟦{保護|ほご}→保護：03625_hogo⟧{水域|すいいき}: protected waters

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{海域|かいいき}→海域：26897_kaiiki⟧: sea area, maritime zone — specifically ocean/sea areas
- ⟦{領海|りょうかい}→領海：15850_ryoukai⟧: territorial waters — a legal term for sovereign sea territory
- ⟦{流域|りゅういき}→流域：19664_ryuuiki⟧: river basin, watershed — the area drained by a river system
